newsitem.title: USA: Smith Barney director suspended - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Smith Barney director suspended - NYT.

text.p: Smith Barney Inc. has suspended its director for the Northeast region as it conducts an investigation into his role in soliciting campaign contributions, the New York Times said.
In its Wednesday edition, the Times quoted a Smith Barney spokeswoman as saying that Robert Maloney was placed on administrative leave as of last Friday.

An unnamed person familiar with the investigation said the Federal Election Commission and the U.S. attorney's office in Boston, where Maloney is based, were looking into what role he may have played in getting other members of the firm to make campaign contributions.
The Times did not say which campaign or campaigns may have been involved.
Smith Barney is the brokerage subsidiary of the Travelers Group Inc.
